verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a public developer API at tryjeeves.redocly.app/apis covering cards, payments, transactions and expense data, launched December 2025. The docs specify mTLS and OAuth 2.0 authentication, give concrete endpoints such as POST /v1/cards/transactions and the full-lifecycle Boleto API, and list TypeScript and Python SDKs plus signed webhooks. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed spec paths returned 404), broader per-endpoint documentation beyond a few examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API is publicly accessible and works as described.
